title: JanuScope audit event
description: One line of the JanuScope JSONL audit log. Mirrors the `AuditEvent` TypeScript type exported from the `januscope` package. Consumers building SIEM ingesters should validate each line against this schema before parsing.

Timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; same string the overlay generates with Date.toISOString().

ArgsHash.description: sha256:<first-16-hex-chars> of the canonical-JSON of the tool's arguments. Stable across argument key ordering.

Classification.description: Lens data-sensitivity label, inherited from OverlayConfig.classification. Present on every record when the lens sets it; omitted otherwise.

Identity.description: Optional identity attribution captured at overlay setup from JANUSCOPE_USER / JANUSCOPE_TEAM / JANUSCOPE_SESSION env vars. Each field is independently optional and omitted when its env var is unset / empty. Pre-existing audit consumers parsing the legacy shape are unaffected. Composed into the event types via `allOf`; strict 'no extra properties' is enforced at the composed-event level via `unevaluatedProperties: false` (Draft 2020-12 idiom for `allOf` composition — `additionalProperties: false` here would reject every field defined in the sibling subschema).

user.description: Free-form operator identifier (username, email, employee id). SIEM ingesters typically join this against an HRIS / IDP table.

session.description: Client-side correlation id (e.g. an MCP-client session uuid). Enables cross-process tracing without distributed-tracing infrastructure.

tool.description: Tool name from params.name, or '<unknown>' if absent.

id.description: JSON-RPC request id used for request/response correlation.

args.description: Raw arguments. Present only when the overlay is configured with logRawArgs: true. Opaque JSON — may contain secrets.

sink.description: Configured sink string: 'stdout', 'stderr', or a file path.

result_bytes.description: UTF-8 byte count of the serialised result (not character count).
